evals.prompt: Add a new 'notes' text field to our CodeIgniter 4 Reservation form. Show what needs to change in the Model and Controller so users can submit it.
evals.expected_output: Adds notes to $allowedFields deliberately (a legitimate, low-risk field), without suggesting widening allowedFields broadly or removing validation, and does not touch CSRF protection as part of this unrelated change.

assertions.text: Adds the field to allowedFields explicitly rather than removing/bypassing the guard
Does not suggest disabling CSRF protection to make the form work

evals.prompt: Our CodeIgniter 4 app uses session-based authentication and currently has Config\Security::$csrfProtection set to 'cookie' (the default). Is this fine?
evals.expected_output: Flags that cookie-based CSRF does not protect against same-site attacks and recommends switching to 'session'-based CSRF protection since the app already maintains server-side sessions for auth.

assertions.text: Explains the same-site weakness of cookie-based CSRF
